outcome: restored therapeutic eculizumab level and activity
cohort: A 30-year-old pregnant female with hypoplastic myelodysplastic syndrome and paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH) who was receiving eculizumab treatment.
finding: Escalation of eculizumab dose successfully controlled breakthrough hemolysis and restored therapeutic drug levels, leading to the delivery of a healthy baby in a pregnant patient with PNH.
